name: Accordion
description: Stacked sections that expand and collapse: each item is a heading holding a button that shows or hides its panel. One item open at a time, or several with multiple.

livewire.name: accordion
capabilities: Children: accordion-item, each rendering its heading, trigger and panel; items renders the same children from data
wire:model binds the open items' values

react.name: Accordion
capabilities: Children: AccordionItem, each rendering its heading, trigger and panel; items renders the same children from data

vue.name: Accordion
capabilities: Children: AccordionItem, each rendering its heading, trigger and panel; items renders the same children from data

props.name: value
props.description: The open items' values. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model. Setting it doesn't fire value-change.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The items open at first in an uncontrolled accordion. The spec's defaultOpen.

props.name: items
props.description: The items as data, rendering the same children as composition: { value, title, content, disabled }.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Lets several items be open at once. Off, opening an item closes the others. The spec's type: single · multiple. Emitted as data-multiple.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets the open item of a single accordion close, leaving none open. Emitted as data-collapsible.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default is one container with edges between items, separated gives each item its own container, and flush drops the container for use inside a card or page. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The level of each item's heading, h2 to h6, so the accordion fits the page's outline.
props.a11y: Pick the level below the heading the accordion sits under.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every item: the triggers can't be focused or toggled. An item can also be disabled on its own.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { item: '…', trigger: '…' }.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One section: its title and its panel. data-state is open or closed.

parts.name: title
parts.description: The heading around the trigger, at headingLevel. The spec calls it heading; title is the vocabulary's name.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button that toggles the item: aria-expanded, and aria-controls its panel. Zag's itemTrigger, named as the spec does.

parts.name: chevron
parts.description: The chevron at the trigger's end. It points down and turns up while the item is open. Zag's itemIndicator.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The item's panel: role region, labelled by its trigger and hidden while closed. The spec calls it panel; Zag's itemContent, named content as in Tabs (D-019).

events.name: value-change
events.description: An item opened or closed, by click or the keyboard. Setting value doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Opens or closes the focused item.
Moves through the triggers and into an open panel's content.
Moves to the next or previous trigger, skipping disabled items.
Moves to the first or last trigger.

requirements: Each trigger is a button inside a heading (headingLevel), with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at its panel.
Each panel is role=region, labelled by its trigger, and hidden while its item is closed.
Disabled items set disabled on the trigger and are skipped by the arrow keys.
The chevron is aria-hidden; the open state is in aria-expanded, not in the icon alone.
Don't hide required form fields in collapsed items.
The focus ring shows on the focused trigger, inset so the container doesn't clip it.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire (D-015).

items.title: How long does a listing stay live?
items.content: Listings stay live until you archive them or mark them as sold. Drafts are kept for 90 days.

items.title: Can co-owners edit a listing?
items.content: Yes. Invite them from the listing's Sharing tab.

items.title: Which file types can I upload?
items.content: Images, PDFs and floor plans up to 20 MB each.
